pick.name: Personal savings account at an AD Category-I bank (now) -> current account at the same bank once you register a proprietorship/GST
pick.what: Receive MoR/Skydo/Wise INR payouts in your own name
pick.why: Wise's freelancer type explicitly uses an INR account in your personal name; no company needed to start
pick.free_limits: Bank-specific; confirm the bank accepts export proceeds into a savings account and issues FIRA/eBRC

alts.why: Payout APIs + current account in one dashboard
alts.free_limits: Sole-prop docs: proprietor KYC, company seal on pages, account-opening cheque Rs20,000-Rs10,00,000 (RBL/YBL route); RazorpayX is not a bank

decision: Don't pay for a current account before you have a GSTIN/Udyam proof; collect into your personal account (as Wise's freelancer type expects) and open a current account when you register.
details: Whether each bank accepts export receipts into savings is bank-specific (unverified).

verify.note: Reasonable. The Wise source supports personal-name INR accounts for the freelancer type. Whether banks accept export proceeds into savings accounts remains bank-specific and unverified.
